stages.label: ss-fit aa-scene

reasons: 65 sampling gap(s) exceeded 27ms; motion during those gaps was not judged

findings: clipped: div.aa-orbit clipped right by 75px, bottom by 122px by div.aa-cover (14 frames from 0.0s)
clipped: div.aa-orbit clipped right by 105px, bottom by 91px by div.aa-cover (14 frames from 0.0s)
uneven padding: div.aa-cover has bottom -122px against 18px at the side; a card pads its content the same on every side (the outer radius is the inner radius plus the padding) (13 frames from 0.0s)
framing: div.ss-phone ends 16px short of the right edge; give it a full gutter (24px) or run it well past the edge so it is clearly masked (14 frames from 0.0s)
small text: span "3:32" renders at 9.1px on a phone; the floor is about 10px, so lay compact out at the column's width and set its type for it, not shrunk from the wide design (14 frames from 0.0s)

half-pixel glyph: a 18px svg.lucide centered in the 152x19 span.ss-states__item sits on a half pixel, so it draws there while span.ss-states__item moves and hops sideways when it settles; size it 18px in an even box (even inside even) (6.0s, 7.2s)

lands on a transform: div.ss-expand__content "Now playingA little " comes to rest at the end of a transform, so its text hops a fraction of a pixel as it lands; keep it on a layer for good (will-change: transform), or scale only its surface
